title: Kotebe & Yeka Moving Guide: Hills, Schools & Family Relocations
excerpt: Kotebe and upper Yeka moves: hilly access, school-zone timing, family compounds, and links to Megenagna and Kotebe university corridor traffic.
content:
Kotebe and upper Yeka

Kotebe and the upper Yeka slopes mix family compounds, newer condos, and institutions that generate steady relocation demand. Moves here add grade and road width to the usual condo checklist—trucks may not reach the door, and school traffic defines your best loading windows.

Access and hills

  • Survey whether a 5-ton can enter the compound or must shuttle from the main road.
  • Rainy season increases slip risk on outdoor stairs—request floor and stair protection.
  • Long carries from gate to door add crew hours; measure distance at walkthrough.
  • Some blocks share one service lift—book consecutive hours for large inventories.

School zones and timing

Morning and afternoon school peaks slow trucks near campuses and family neighborhoods. Prefer loads between 9:30 and 14:30 on weekdays, or early Saturday when management allows weekend freight. Align with our truck timing guide for citywide freight rules.

Routes toward Megenagna and east corridors

Kotebe moves often connect to Megenagna, Shola, or deeper east-side destinations. Cross-sub-city quotes include traffic time—not just map distance. Linking with our Megenagna guide helps if one end of your move sits on the junction side.

Family and multi-bedroom homes

Larger households should declutter before survey—Kotebe villas and townhouses fill trucks faster than expected. Pack a first-night box separately; kids’ rooms last on the truck often unload first at the new home.

Pricing and booking

Starting tiers for condos appear on our 2026 cost guide and homepage table. Book Kotebe movers · Condo checklist

University and institution corridor

Kotebe’s institutional traffic adds buses and pedestrian peaks unrelated to your compound. Avoid loading directly in front of campus gates when security redirects freight. Coordinate with compound management if your route crosses shared access roads.

Shola and Yeka overview links

Addresses near Shola behave like corridor moves—Shola–Megenagna guide. Whole-sub-city planning sits in the Yeka overview.

Group and written quotes

Neighbors moving the same week can share mobilization—group tips. Insist on scope on paper—contract red flags · +251982260000

Rain and Entoto-facing slopes

Kotebe drives toward higher elevation share slippery outdoor stairs in rainy season—schedule indoor packing first. Link hillside discipline with Gullele & Entoto when your route touches foothill segments.

Pricing table

Starting condo tiers on homepage pricing and the 2026 cost guide—survey adds carry and lift fees.

Family multi-bedroom

Three-bedroom homes from about 28,000 ETB as a starting tier—Kotebe villas often exceed that when outdoor stairs and long gates apply.
